- **[When scoped Git change control is enough](products/evidence-registry/study-scoped-git.html).** Both workflows accepted 2 authorized repairs in 4 matched paths. Both restored the remote file state. Scoped Git retained the original effect in ordinary branch ancestry and created 0 additional receipt files. The governed arm retained it on an audit ref and created 14 additional receipt files.
- **[When a second receiver check changes closure](products/evidence-registry/study-crossed-receiver.html).** Both placements verified 8 of 8 withheld-primary cases with 8 caller requests each. Gateway delivery added 2,033 HTTP response bytes per verified fallback across both hops.
- **[Which scope earns a verifier rollout?](products/evidence-registry/study-verifier-rollout.html).** The shared copy-09 failure routed to a specialist. Both workflows matched the expected route at 66 scripted checkpoints and each read 75 evidence documents. The serialized handoff wrote 2367 bytes. Both caught a missed invalidation when the index next returned the current revision.
